name: How does hurricane season impact living in Fort Lauderdale, and what preparation is recommended?

mainEntity.name: How does hurricane season impact living in Fort Lauderdale, and what preparation is recommended?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hurricane season, from June 1st to November 30th, is a factor when living in Fort Lauderdale. While the city has robust preparedness plans, residents should also take individual steps. This includes securing properties, developing an evacuation plan, and having an emergency kit ready with essential supplies. Newer constructions often include hurricane-resistant features, but it's important to understand your property's specific vulnerabilities and insurance coverage. A local real estate professional can offer guidance on homes with impact-resistant windows or other protective measures, providing peace of mind during storm season.
